Change c0484. Location: 1818 Vol. III, Ch. VII; 1831 Ch. XXIV.

Context before (unchanged): In other places human beings were seldom seen; and I generally subsisted on the wild animals that crossed my path.

1818 text: I had money with me, and gained the friendship of the villagers by distributing it, or bringing with me some food that I had killed, which, after taking a small part, I always presented to those who had provided me with fire and utensils for cooking.

1831 text: I had money with me, and gained the friendship of the villagers by distributing it; or I brought with me some food that I had killed, which, after taking a small part, I always presented to those who had provided me with fire and utensils for cooking.

Diff: I had money with me, and gained the friendship of the villagers by distributing it [-,-] {+;+} or [-bringing-] {+I brought+} with me some food that I had killed, which, after taking a small part, I always presented to those who had provided me with fire and utensils for cooking.

Context after (unchanged): My life, as it passed thus, was indeed hateful to me, and it was during sleep alone that I could taste joy.

result.rationale: Comma replaced by semicolon and participle 'bringing' changed to finite clause 'I brought'; syntax and meaning are unchanged, so this is a grammatical rephrasing with no interpretive consequence.
